_comment: Round 06 - FIVE humanoid war mechs. Two lessons are being applied at once. (1) ARCHETYPE: the roster is taken from R02 (the set the user prefers over R01) plus r04_04, with the weapons corrected per the user's note that r02_01's slim body should carry a sniper rifle rather than a blade. Every machine is humanoid: two legs, two arms, a head. No drones, no quadrupeds, no spiders. (2) STYLE LOCK: round 04 was rejected because the machines looked like five different films. The livery, materials, construction vocabulary, wear, camera, light and rune layer live ONLY in the shared styleSuffix, so the set reads as one production line. Per-concept text names archetype, weapon, pose and ONE accent colour - nothing else.
_styleDecision: R02's machines, as field-worn military hardsuits: R02's tapered bone-white hero plating and rune layer, plus r04_02's matte honest wear, with chunky exposed hardsuit joints. One locked livery across all five; per-machine accent colour is the only permitted variation.
promptPrefix: A single full-body hero concept-art portrait of a humanoid war machine, two legs and two arms, a head above the shoulders and a torso between them,
styleSuffix: . Every machine in this set is built the same way: matte hardened bone-white composite plating with thin dark seam lines over a near-black mechanical frame, sand-olive drab panels on the lower legs and the shoulders, chunky exposed hydraulic actuators at the hips, knees and elbows, tapered hard-edged panel forms, a family of low angular sensor-head housings, broad clawed feet. The plating is honest and used rather than showroom gloss: a uniform chalky grey dust film settled on the upward-facing surfaces, worn and chipped edges showing the darker material underneath, grime and oil caught in the recesses, faint scuffing around every joint. Etched across the armour of every machine is the same layer of runic decoration: angular geometric glyphs cut into the plating as narrow recessed channels with a faint luminous glow sitting inside them, arranged as bands, columns and chevrons that follow the forms of the machine, abstract and non-linguistic, never as letters, words or numbers. Shot identically on every machine: a three-quarter front view from the left, camera at chest height, a 50mm lens, the whole machine in frame from crest to feet with clear air around it. Standing on a seamless neutral silver-grey studio backdrop with a soft contact shadow under its feet. The backdrop is plain and empty: no landscape, no sky, no horizon, no ground scenery, no buildings, no props, no weapons on the ground. Nothing else in the frame except the machine and its shadow. Painterly semi-realistic 'real robot' mecha illustration, smooth airbrushed gradients, soft volumetric haze, gentle film grain, studio key light high above and slightly to the left, falling on the machine only, cool soft fill on the camera-facing side, a bright thin edge highlight running down the left side of the machine, flat even overhead ambient lighting on the floor, the floor a matte plane of one uniform neutral grey with no horizontal gradient across it, all the way to every edge of the frame, with no directional falloff, no pool of light, no bright corner, no dark corner and no reflection. Crisp readable silhouette with clear negative space between the limbs, fine mechanical detail, deep contact shadows. No text, no lettering, no watermark, no extra limbs, no duplicated parts, no duplicated weapon, no scenery.

concepts.name: 01_recon_sniper
concepts.prompt: a fast, agile scout mech built to find targets at extreme range and kill them from far off. Lean forward-leaning silhouette with a narrow chest, narrow shoulders and long thin legs held in a ready stance, a small head with a single horizontal visor slit, one arm shouldering a long sniper rifle held high and pointing forward past the body, a compact scope mounted on a short top rail above the barrel, the other arm a short clawed support arm held at the hip, a slim torso tapering to a point at the front, a low swept crest fin rising from the back of the head, narrow blade-like shin armour, a single amber accent stripe running along the rifle stock and down the shin
concepts.subject: a slim humanoid scout mech with long thin legs shouldering a long sniper rifle
